## Description
Please include a summary of the change, related issues, and which Clean Architecture layer it affects (`src/core`, `src/sanitization`, `src/plugins`, `src/ui`).

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature / Plugin (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring / Clean Architecture refinement

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and Clean Architecture of this project.
- [ ] I have verified that all existing features work without errors in `index.html`.
- [ ] I have updated `types/index.d.ts` if I altered public API signatures.
- [ ] I have updated documentation/README if applicable.
